notes.title: Brazilian Portuguese translation now available!
notes.notes:
Very happy to kick off the new year with a Brazilian Portuguese translation of A Bewitching Revolution! Enormous thanks to Arthur Pieri (@tutupieri on Twitter) for all his work on this ❤️

[i][b]Bruxa da cidade, atenda nossa prece![/b][/i]

The update also includes some long overdue bug fixes and accessibility options:

[list]
[*] Added FOV + mouse sensitivity sliders
[*] Fixed some pathfinding bugs which could soft-lock the game's final act
[*] A bunch of other minor fixes/tweaks
[/list]
